title: fix(console): a mobile hand-off sign-up's verification mail lands on "go back to the app", and the refusal time survives /verify-email-prompt
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB9Gxsdodaojru82bMqqCx3b)_

Fixes #30157

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：移动端登录（hand-off）途中注册、服务器要求验证邮箱时，验证邮件的链接不再指向 `/_console/api/v1/auth/one-time-token/handoff`，而是落到 Console 的「邮箱已确认，请回到 App 登录」页（`/verify-email?handoff=verified`），在打开邮件的浏览器里不发登录令牌；同时 `handoff_refused_at` 在经过 `/verify-email-prompt` 的三跳上不再丢失。
- **为什么改**：实测（dev boot）：打开邮件的浏览器已登录任何账号时落到「Page not found」；未登录时被 Console 的登录守卫碰巧带到带 hand-off 的登录页。邮件通常不在 App 等待的系统登录窗口里打开，常常在另一台设备上，所以落地页改为「回 App 登录」。落地页由用户在 2026-11-05 03:06Z 的决策卡上选定（「回 App 提示页」）。
- **风险与回滚**：只有 hand-off redirect 换落地页；邀请等其他 redirect 的邮件链接与三跳链接逐字节不变（对照测试钉住）；服务端路由、令牌发放、hand-off 端点一行未动。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/handoffRedirect.ts`（新的 `verificationCallbackURL` 与规则 6）、`VerifyEmailPage.tsx`（无 token 的 `handoff=verified` 落地分支）、`RegisterPage.tsx` / `VerifyEmailPromptPage.tsx` 的两处 callbackURL。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/handoffVerificationMail-30157.test.tsx`，预期 1 个文件、11 条全部通过。
- **需要你做的**：这是会话转移（auth）流程，请维护者审阅并合并本 PR。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/handoffRedirect.ts`: a new rule 6 in the header ("not from the verification mail") and `verificationCallbackURL(redirect)`: a hand-off `redirect` (the existing `handoffNavigationTarget` matcher, unchanged) returns to `/verify-email?handoff=verified` inside the Console mount; any other safe in-app `redirect` is resolved with `withConsoleBaseRootRelative` exactly as before; an unsafe or missing one gives no `callbackURL`, as before. `withConsoleBaseRootRelative` itself is untouched.
- `RegisterPage.tsx` (the sign-up mail) and `VerifyEmailPromptPage.tsx` (the "Resend" mail) build their `callbackURL` through it.
- `VerifyEmailPage.tsx`: with no `token` and `?handoff=verified`, the server has already verified the address (better-auth 302s to the callback after `GET /verify-email`), so the page spends no token of its own and shows "Email verified" with "Go back to the app you were signing in to, and sign in there", and no Console sign-in link. better-auth appends `error=CODE` to the callback for a bad or expired token; the page then shows its existing failure state. Without the mark, a token-less visit still reports the missing token.
- The refusal time: `handoffMarkQuery(redirect)` is appended on `LoginPage`'s `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` navigation, `RegisterPage`'s `onVerificationRequired` navigation and `VerifyEmailPromptPage.handleBackToLogin`. It is empty unless the redirect names the hand-off and the page carries a mark, so every other link is unchanged.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: `auth.verifyEmail.handoffSuccessDescription` in all ten locales.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n`, patch.

No server file moves: no auth route, no token issuance, no change to the hand-off endpoint.

## The landing, and what it does for a person who opens the mail elsewhere

Three landings were defensible, with different results for the person; the project's user chose this one on a decision card (2026-11-05 03:06Z, option 「回 App 提示页」, "back-to-the-app page"):

- **Chosen: "go back to the app".** The link verifies the address and lands on `/verify-email?handoff=verified`: "Email verified. Go back to the app you were signing in to, and sign in there." Whatever browser or device opens the mail (a desktop browser, Safari while the app waits in an `ASWebAuthenticationSession`, a browser signed in as someone else), the person sees that page and no sign-in token is handed out there. Back in the app's waiting window, which still shows `/verify-email-prompt`, "Back to login" (now carrying the route's mark) and one sign-in finish the hand-off. This keeps the route's own rule that every hand-off follows a full sign-in in the system auth session.
- Not chosen: return to `/login` carrying the hand-off, so the mail browser signs in and is forwarded to the route. Smoother on Android, where Custom Tabs share Chrome's cookies and the scheme opens the app by intent; on iOS it relies on the app taking a cold scheme open, and on another device it ends at a scheme nothing opens. (This is what a signed-out mail browser got before this PR, by way of the SPA's sign-in guard.)
- Not chosen: plain Console `/login` with no hand-off, which signs the person into the web Console instead of the app.

## Tests

<details><summary>New pins: handoffVerificationMail-30157.test.tsx (11 tests)</summary>

The real `AuthProvider` over a mock client, the Console mounted as the shipped embeddable build (`base href /_console/`, `BASE_URL` `./`); `callbackURL` is read off the client call that goes on the wire.

- The mail link: the sign-up mail's `callbackURL` is `/_console/verify-email?handoff=verified`; the resent mail's too. CONTROL: an invitation redirect keeps `/_console/accept-invitation/inv_1` on both mails.
- One pin per hop, with the mark `&handoff_refused_at=1793620800000` on the page and a hand-off redirect: `/login` EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED, `/register` verification required, "Back to login" each carry it. CONTROL: beside an invitation redirect the three navigations are byte for byte today's; beside a hand-off redirect with no mark on the page they are today's too.
- The landing: `?handoff=verified` shows the confirmed state, no "Go to sign in" link, and no `/verify-email` fetch; `&error=INVALID_TOKEN` shows the failure state; CONTROL: no token and no mark still reports the missing token.

Run: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/handoffVerificationMail-30157.test.tsx` → Test Files 1 passed, Tests 11 passed.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation</summary>

The fix committed first (`9d2f99aa`), then the five Console source files checked out from `origin/main` inside a script with a restore trap; landing proved by `grep -c` (`verificationCallbackURL` 0 hits in `handoffRedirect.ts`, `handoffMarkQuery` 0 hits in `VerifyEmailPromptPage.tsx`). Result: Tests 6 failed, 5 passed: the two mail pins, the three hop pins and the landing pin went red; the controls stayed green (as they should: they assert today's behaviour). Restore by `git checkout HEAD --`; `git diff HEAD` empty and each file's hash equals its HEAD blob. No build in the loop: the Console tests import these files from source.
</details>

## Verification

<details><summary>Browser walk on a dev boot (shots in the project's ui-orders/30157-shots)</summary>

`examples/app-crm`, `pnpm exec objectstack dev --fresh`, `OS_TRUSTED_APP_SCHEMES=ai.objectos.mobile`, `OS_AUTH_REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=true`, audience posture `open` (settings `auth`), log mail provider (the mail read from `sys_identity_email`). Headless Chromium: window A opens the hand-off route (302 to `/_console/login?redirect=…&handoff_refused_at=…`), follows "Sign up", registers; window B (a separate browser context) opens the mail's link; A then presses "Back to login" and signs in.

Before (Console built from `origin/main` `dfafae813`):
- The mail's link: `callbackURL=/_console/api/v1/auth/one-time-token/handoff?redirect_uri=…`.
- B signed in as any account: `302` from `/verify-email`, then the Console's "Page not found" (`before-signedin-3-mail-lands.png`).
- B signed out (the stock case: `os serve` cannot turn on `autoSignInAfterVerification`): the SPA's sign-in guard sends it to `/_console/login?redirect=/api/v1/auth/one-time-token/handoff…`, so the mail browser is offered the hand-off by accident (`before-3-mail-lands.png`).
- `/verify-email-prompt` and "Back to login" carry no `handoff_refused_at` (`before-walk.json`, steps 3 and 6).

After (this branch's Console):
- The mail's link: `callbackURL=/_console/verify-email?handoff=verified`.
- B signed out and B signed in both land on "Email verified. Go back to the app you were signing in to, and sign in there." (`after-3-mail-lands.png`, `after-signedin-3-mail-lands.png`).
- The prompt and "Back to login" carry `handoff_refused_at` (`after-walk.json`, steps 3 and 6); signing in on A forwards to the route, which answers `302 ai.objectos.mobile://auth/callback?token=…` (step 7).
</details>

<details><summary>Gates (local, head 9d2f99aa, one locked run, 40 commands, every one exit 0)</summary>

- Card checks: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/auth/` (Test Files 28 passed, Tests 228 passed); `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/` (95 files, 1443 passed, 13 skipped); `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run type-check`; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check`; `eslint` on the six changed Console files.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and its `--self-test`: exit 0.
- All 35 families `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for this diff: exit 0 each (list in the project's ui-orders/30157-gates-ran.list). `--ran` reconciliation: "35 derived famil(ies) accounted for, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- The repo-wide lint and Test Core / Test UI shards are CI's.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Premise, measured: the dead end ("Page not found") appears only when the browser that opens the mail holds a Console session. A signed-out browser reached a sign-in page carrying the hand-off, by way of the SPA's guard rather than by design. Both now land on the same page.
- `autoSignInAfterVerification` is not reachable on a stock `os serve`; on a host that turns it on, the mail browser gets a session for the new account and still lands on the same page, which offers no Console link.
- The waiting window is not told that the address was verified elsewhere; the person returns to it and presses "Back to login" (which now keeps the mark), as before.
